notes.title: Great news!
notes.content:
Here is a list of the new features:
[list]
[*] Crop videos with pinpoint accuracy
[*] Preview clips so you can delete unwanted segments with ease
[*] Undo and Redo tool will help you apply and cancel changes
[*] Scale up the timeline so you can cut your video more precisely
[/list]
You can convert movies, too. The SuperSpeed mode changes file formats in the blink of an eye and even saves at HD quality.
